lemmas.primary_translation: to have a sudden wicked or evil impulse / to suddenly feel like doing something

definitions.text: få en plutselig slem eller ond innskytelse
definitions.translation: to get a sudden nasty or evil impulse (lit. a devil gets into someone)

definitions.text: få en plutselig lyst til å gjennomføre noe
definitions.translation: to suddenly feel an urge to carry something out

examples.no: det gikk en djevel i meg da jeg fikk mulighet til hevn
examples.en: a devil got into me when I got the opportunity for revenge

examples.no: det for en djevel i laget i andre omgang
examples.en: a devil got into the team in the second half
